info.title: TopxAI API
info.summary: One OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoint for Claude, GPT, Grok, GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek and Jev.
info.description: TopxAI relays requests to the model providers at fixed USD prices on prepaid credit. The request body is forwarded unchanged and the response is returned unchanged, except where a request in another format has to be converted for the model (for example /v1/messages to a model other than Claude), on /v1/responses, where the echoes of the request and members the upstream adds are rewritten, and on /v1/chat/completions, where provider_specific_fields, a member some upstream capacity adds, is removed; parameters not listed here pass through to the provider. A request without a system prompt that reaches the GPT provider's Responses API (gpt-6.1-sol on every endpoint, gpt-6-astra on /v1/responses) is sent the instructions "You are a helpful assistant.", so the provider does not add its own longer prompt; a request with its own system prompt or instructions is forwarded as sent. Base URL for OpenAI-style SDKs: https://ai.topxea.com/v1. Base URL for the Anthropic SDK: https://ai.topxea.com. Prompts, completions and files are relayed in memory and never stored. Prices: https://ai.topxea.com/pricing and https://ai.topxea.com/api/pricing.

post.description: Anthropic Messages API for every text model except Jev. Claude models get the request in Anthropic's own format, cache_control included, and prompt caching bills at the cache-read and cache-write prices; the relay sets a missing max_tokens to the model's output limit and drops service_tier, inference_geo and speed. The other models get a conversion and answer in the Messages format: gpt-6.1-sol through the Responses API, the rest through Chat Completions. Send the key as x-api-key (the Anthropic SDK does) or as a Bearer token. Without max_tokens, DeepSeek also gets the model's output limit (cut to what the context window leaves after the prompt) and the other converted models are sent no cap. The Chat Completions conversion keeps cache_control on text, image and document blocks only, and the Responses conversion drops it. On the Chat Completions models a tool_result keeps its text on the tool message and its images move to the following user message, and a tool_result holding a document is a 400; thinking blocks in the history are dropped on gpt-6.1-sol, and redacted_thinking blocks on every converted model; stop_sequences on grok-4.7 is a 400; GLM-5.3-Abliterated takes text only and fails with a 400 on an image or document block.

post.description: TypeSafe's System One: typed questions about a state, answered with probabilities (or, for Box, the edges of a box in an image) instead of text. Model jev-1.14.0; jev-latest and jev-preview are accepted and answered by jev-1.14.0. $0.04494 per 1M input tokens, image tokens included, output free. /v1/system_one is accepted as a second spelling. The body must carry model, state and a non-empty questions object; state and questions together are at most 1 MiB, the whole body at most 32 MiB, and assets at most 1,024 images with reference strings of at most 1,024 bytes each and 64 KiB together. Images (PNG or JPEG) are listed once in assets under a reference string and placed by writing that reference in the state, an instruction or a criterion; send them base64-encoded in the JSON body or as file parts of a multipart/form-data body whose first part, named request, holds the JSON. Images and Box questions are an experimental TypeSafe feature: the relay adds the TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Images header the provider requires, so it is optional here.

additionalProperties.description: One image file part (image/png, image/jpeg or application/octet-stream) per asset, under the name its asset gives in part.

400.description: The body failed the relay's checks (Error), or TypeSafe rejected it: an image it cannot read or outside its size limits, an asset nobody references, a request over the context length (SystemOneProviderError). Nothing is charged.

413.description: The body is over 32 MiB (Error), or TypeSafe found an image or all images together over its size limits (SystemOneProviderError). Nothing is charged.

anthropicKey.name: x-api-key
anthropicKey.description: The same TopxAI key, the way the Anthropic SDK sends it.

message.description: Ends with a request id to quote to support@topxea.com.

content.description: Text, or content parts (text, image_url) as the provider defines them.

ChatCompletionRequest.description: OpenAI's Chat Completions body; fields not listed pass through to the provider.

instructions.description: The system prompt. When it is missing or blank, input has no system or developer item and no stored prompt is named, gpt-6-astra and gpt-6.1-sol are sent "You are a helpful assistant." so the provider does not add its own longer prompt; the answer still echoes the value the request sent.

max_tokens.description: Without it, Claude and DeepSeek get the model's output limit and the other models are sent no cap.

system.description: A system prompt as a string or content blocks. TopxAI adds none of its own, except that a gpt-6.1-sol request without one is sent the instructions "You are a helpful assistant." so the provider does not add its own longer prompt.

size.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT with a plain x; omitted or auto is pinned to 1024x1024. The pixel count picks the 1K or 2K tier.

quality.description: Validated, does not change the fee.

duration.description: Seconds of video; the fee is duration times the per-second price.

image.description: Image-to-video input, as xAI defines it.

type.description: noul (probability of yes), choice (one option of criteria, with a probability per option), score (a value across ordered criteria levels) or box (where the target is in an image: top, bottom, left and right as fractions of the image).

instructions.description: The question, or for box what to find and in which image. A string, or an object or array that holds the question and data it refers to; may contain image references.

criteria.description: noul: optional {true, false} definitions. choice: object of option name to description (or null), at most 255 options. score: ordered array of 2 to 10 level descriptions. box: none. Descriptions may contain image references.

state.description: What the questions are about: a string, or structured JSON such as a record or a chat log; image references may appear in it. Default limits: 64k tokens per request and 32k per question, the state included.

assets.description: Images keyed by reference string. Every reference must appear in the state, an instruction or a criterion; each appearance adds the image again.

data_base64.description: The image file, standard base64 with padding, no data: prefix. PNG or JPEG, 280 to 1568 pixels on each side as measured on 2026-10-16 (TypeSafe documents 256).

part.description: In a multipart body, the name of the file part holding the image.

SystemOneProviderError.description: TypeSafe's own error body, passed through as written (the channel key and upstream hosts removed).

detail.description: An object with error_type and message, or a list of field errors.

context_window.description: Input context window in tokens; omitted when unknown or not applicable.

max_output.description: Maximum output tokens; omitted when unknown or not applicable.
